thesis: Benefit-first creative produced 0 sign-ups in matched cells while outcome and story each produced 3; lean away from benefit-led openings.
Auto-mode sales cells were unreadable two batches running ($80 of NO-TRUST spend); cut auto-mode and fund only fixed single-audience cells.
Funded benefit re-test falsified the benefit demotion (6 sign-ups at $2.22 CPL in the matched pageviews-broad cell); restore benefit-led creative.
Plain benefit-led creative in pageviews-broad is the engine — replicated best CPL two eras and all 3 purchases this batch; put half the budget there.
Winning angle is cell-dependent — benefit wins pageviews-broad three eras running while outcome wins sales-broad both funded eras; assign angles per cell.
Demo variant improves outcome-led creative — outcome-with-demo beat plain outcome in all four matched cells; attach demo to outcome ads.
Verbatim creative reuse fatigues — the identical benefit prompt decayed monotonically over five eras in pageviews-broad; write fresh executions each batch.
Fatigue confirmed — fresh benefit briefs recovered pv-broad CTR/CPL and took a purchase; forbid verbatim prompt reuse outside deliberate re-tests.
